entries.title: RxMER playback needs a longer run
entries.faq_heading: RxMER playback needs a longer run
entries.summary: The last RxMER capture transition must fit inside the source observation window.
entries.context: Final transition: {final_transition_ms} ms (symbol {final_transition_symbol}). Current duration: {current_duration_ms} ms.
entries.suggestion: Set Configure WorkBench → Run → Duration per Profile to at least {minimum_duration_ms} ms, or reduce OFDM symbols between captures / the capture count.
entries.over_limit_suggestion: This sequence needs at least {minimum_duration_ms} ms, above the {maximum_duration_ms} ms duration limit. Reduce OFDM symbols between captures / the capture count, or use Single capture / Average mode.
entries.note: Increasing the active run budget does not extend the observation window.

entries.title: QAM profile has no retained result
entries.faq_heading: QAM profile has no retained result
entries.summary: Imported profile IDs are separate from completed simulation results.
entries.suggestion: In Configure WorkBench, select the desired profiles, apply the configuration and run them. Wait for the selected run to complete, then choose its Run Profile in the analyzer.
entries.note: Opening a WB does not run it. Start or accepted input changes clear transient results. Missing results never use another profile’s samples.
